messages:
liz: Quick heads up — found an issue in month-end close for ACME Corp. Invoice INV-9876 was posted as fully recognized revenue instead of being deferred. Need to recast before we lock March. Details below.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-9876 | Amount: $120,000 | Issue date: 2026-03-01 | Link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-9876 

omar: Can you confirm contract term and start date? How much should've been recognized in March?

liz: Term is 12 months starting 2026-03-01. Monthly recognized revenue = $10,000. They were billed $120,000 up front and we incorrectly recognized the full $120k on posting. Correct treatment is to recognize $10k for March and defer $110k for the remaining 11 months.

sasha: OK. What's the proposed journal entry and GL accounts?

liz: Proposed JE (recast):
```
Dr Sales Revenue (GL 4000) $110,000
Cr Deferred Revenue (GL 2300) $110,000
```
Narrative: Reverse over-recognition posted on 3/1 and move to deferred revenue for remaining contract term. Impact: reduces March recognized revenue by $110k (one-time adjustment).

matt: I'll need the original invoice posting refs and batch id to reverse. What's the original JE id?

liz: Original AR application / posting reference: APPL-20260301-INV9876. Revenue batch REF: REV-20260301. Billing export (CSV) attached to the ticket — minimal reference above in case attachment doesn't render.

matt: Got it. I can post an adjusting journal under batch ADJ-ME-1803. Will you include the contract id in the memo?

liz: Yes — Contract ACME-2026-SaaS. Memo line: 'Recast March close — reverse prepaid recognition to deferred for INV-9876.'

omar: Quick question for reporting/FP&A: do we need to restate any published dashboards or call this a prior-period correction?

sasha: FP&A here — we'll treat as a prior-period adjustment for March P&L and flag it in the close pack. This will reduce recognized revenue for March by $110k. It does affect month ARR/recognized rev metrics; we'll annotate the variance commentary.

matt: Who owns approval for posting? Per policy, CFO sign-off for adjustments > $100k.

liz: @jordan (CFO) — can you approve the JE? It's $110k reclass from revenue to deferred.

jordan (CFO): Approved. Please include the supporting contract and billing export in the workpapers and reference the original posting. @matt go ahead and post once docs are attached. :white_check_mark:

matt: Will post now under ADJ-ME-1803, entering memo and attaching support. ETA 20–30 min. Will ping here when complete.

billing-bot: Journal ADJ-ME-1803 posted by matt at 2026-03-31T15:22Z. ID: JE-20260331-4512

matt: Posted and attached: contract ACME-2026-SaaS.pdf, billing_export_INV-9876.csv, posting_ref_APPL-20260301.pdf. Reconciliation updated.

sasha: Received docs. Updating March close pack. Noting $110k reclass under 'Revenue corrections' and adding variance note for Sales Ops.

liz: Thanks all — closing loop. I'll notify Sales Ops and update the ACME customer record. Leaving thread open for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
